newsitem.title: USA: USAF manual insults Latin Americans - report.
newsitem.headline: USAF manual insults Latin Americans - report.

text.p: A decade-old U.S. Air Force manual aimed at instructing personnel on how to deal with Latin Americans contained racist and insulting comments, CBS/Telenoticias news channel said on Wednesday.

"The mulattos can make themselves white with money and the Indians can make themselves mestizos (mixed race) by changing their clothes," said the text, the Spanish-language channel said in a report form Washington.

The informatin in the manual entitled "Introduction to Understanding Latin Americans," which the Pentagon says has been withdrawn from circulation, was openly racist and represented the worst stereotypes of Latins, Representative Solomon Ortiz, a Texas Democrat, told Telenoticias.
"They put us all in the same group. They say that we don't think, that we don't how to dress," he said.
Telenoticias quoted the manual as saying: "Latin American students are not analytical ... They do not think about what is going on around them."
Representative Jose Serrano, a New York Democrat, called it an "insulting document," adding, "I don't know where these ridiculous ideas come from."

The Pentagon said the manual was issued in 1988 and was no longer in use. It apologised if anyone had been insulted, it added, according to Telenoticias. The report did not say when the manual was withdrawn.

The text also said that the only way to get anything done in Latin America was through friends, that Latin American woman did not mind being eyed up and down, and that the region shunned technological advances, according to the report.
